title: 第672章 举族轰动第671章 万花主宰的请求
slug: 全族助我加点我举族飞升天界

第672章举族轰动
北玄道域，李家大殿。
李天行看着站在自己眼前的李光宇与紫桃仙子。
虽说刚刚老爹已经给他传讯，让他安排好李光宇与紫桃仙子之间的事情。
但眼前的一幕依旧让他感到极为震惊。
李光宇突破到了浑源领主不说，带回来的这个妻子，其背景同样是拥有主宰坐镇的超然势力。
光是这个名头，就足以让他重视这件事情。
震惊过后，他目光看向李光宇，脸上不禁露出了欣喜的笑容。
“光宇，这位便是你的那位妻子吧！”
李光宇对他拱手回道，“回族长，这位是紫桃！”
说着，他看向紫桃仙子给她介绍道，“紫桃，这位是我们李家族长！”
紫桃仙子闻言，便朝着李天行微微行了一礼，“紫桃见过族长！”
李天行听到紫桃仙子的行礼，脸上的笑容则是变得更加的浓郁。
他高兴得连声道好，“好，很好！”
李光宇突破浑源领主就已经是一件好事，更是与另一个主宰族群强强联合。
这更是喜上加喜的天大好事！
“光宇，这次的事情我一定给你办得漂漂亮亮的。”
如此振奋人心的好事情，也是时候让族人也跟着喜庆喜庆了。
他们李家现在可谓是如日中天，上次李青山的浑源领主庆典尚且没有过去多久。
现如今又迎来喜上加喜的大好事，又怎能不让他激动高兴呢？

李光宇拱手回道，“多谢族长，便全凭族长安排了！”
李天行笑容满面地看向李光宇，“好，你便先带着紫桃姑娘在族中走动走动，至于你们的婚事便交给我去操办了！”
李光宇与紫桃仙子对着李天行微微行礼，而后便走了李家大殿。
此番回到族里，他们先来拜见族长，而后还要紫桃仙子回去拜见自己的父母长辈。
不用李天行提醒，李光宇也知道该怎么做了。
李天行看着李光宇两人离去的方向，脸上的笑容依旧未减半分。
“哈哈哈，不错，当真是不错！”
如今族中除了自家老爹之外，更是有了三位浑源领主级别的强者。
就算把自家老爹排除在外，放眼整个人族疆域，也是极为罕见的了！
更何况，他相信这还远不是终点，未来族中还会涌现更多的浑源领主。
随即，他朝四方传去一道音讯。
没过多久，一位位族老从北玄道域之中纷至赶来。
很快，李家大殿之中便聚集众多族老以及长老。
首位之上，李天行满脸红光看向一众族老笑道，“诸位，接下来我们李家又将迎来天大喜事，诸位可要准备好了！”
众族老面面相觑，不知道族长为何这般说，为何这般高兴！
为首那位族老看向李天行开口询问道，“族长，可是因为那位万花主宰？”
李天行看向他笑道，“与那位万花主宰有些关系。”
第672章举族轰动
见到众族老满脸疑惑，李天行也没有跟他们卖关子，直接说道，“好了，天大好事便是，我等李家又迎来一位新晋浑源领主！”
content_en:
Chapter 672 A sensation in the whole family
Beixuan Dao Domain, Li Family Hall.
Li Tianxing looked at Li Guangyu and Fairy Zitao standing in front of him.
Although his father had just summoned him and asked him to arrange things between Li Guangyu and Zi Tao Fairy.
But the scene before him still shocked him.
Not only did Li Guangyu break through to Lord Hunyuan, the background of the wife he brought back was also that of a transcendent power with a dominant position.
The name alone was enough for him to take this matter seriously.
After the shock, he looked at Li Guangyu, with a delighted smile on his face.
"Guangyu, this must be your wife!"
Li Guangyu handed him over and replied, "Back to the clan leader, this is Zitao!"
With that said, he looked at Fairy Zitao and introduced her, "Zitao, this is the head of our Li family!"
Hearing this, Fairy Zitao bowed slightly to Li Tianxing, "Zitao has met the clan leader!"
When Li Tianxing heard Fairy Zitao's salute, the smile on his face became even richer.
He was so happy that he said hello repeatedly, "Okay, very good!"
Li Guangyu's breakthrough to Lord Hunyuan was already a good thing, and it was also a powerful alliance with another dominant group.
This is even more of a blessing!
"Guangyu, I will handle this matter beautifully for you."
Such an exciting and good thing, it's time for the tribe to celebrate as well.
The Li family is now at its peak. The last celebration of Lord Hunyuan held by Li Qingshan has not been long ago.
Now that great things are coming to him, how can he not be excited and happy?
Li Guangyu cupped his hands and replied, "Thank you very much, Patriarch. I'll let the Patriarch arrange it all!"
Li Tianxing looked at Li Guangyu with a smile on his face, "Okay, you can take Miss Zitao around the clan first, and leave your marriage to me!"
Li Guangyu and Fairy Zitao bowed slightly to Li Tianxing, and then left the Li family hall.
When they returned to the clan this time, they first came to pay homage to the clan leader, and then asked Fairy Zitao to go back and pay homage to their parents and elders.
Li Guangyu knew what to do without Li Tianxing's reminder.
Li Tianxing looked at the direction in which Li Guangyu and the two left, the smile on his face still not diminished by half.
"Hahaha, not bad, it's really good!"
Now, in addition to his father, there are three powerful men at the Hunyuan Lord level in the clan.
Even if you exclude your father, looking at the entire human race territory, it is extremely rare!
What's more, he believes that this is far from the end, and more Hunyuan Lords will emerge in the clan in the future.
Immediately, he sent a message to all directions.
Not long after, clan elders came one after another from Beixuan Dao Domain.
Soon, many clan elders and elders gathered in the Li family hall.
At the top of the list, Li Tianxing looked at the clan elders with a red face and said with a smile, "Everyone, our Li family is about to usher in a great event. You must be ready!"
The clan elders looked at each other, wondering why the clan leader said this and why he was so happy!
The leader of the clan looked at Li Tianxing and asked, "Clan leader, is it because of the Lord of Ten Thousand Flowers?"
Li Tianxing looked at him and smiled, "It has something to do with the Lord of Ten Thousand Flowers."
Chapter 672 A sensation in the whole family
Seeing the doubts on the faces of the clan elders, Li Tianxing did not sell out to them and said directly, "Okay, a great thing is that we are waiting for the Li family to welcome a new Lord Hunyuan!"
